sources.entry: Review Inbox by SummerRiversound - Claude Code mod that keeps GitHub work in a band above the prompt and a drawer: pull requests awaiting review, each summarized before it is opened, the user's own open PRs, and issues that mention or are assigned to them. Picked PRs go into the prompt as review requests carrying a review-style line learned from past review comments.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code mod that shows your GitHub review queue, your own PRs, and assigned or mentioning issues in a band above the prompt and a drawer, with optional background auto-reviews.
summary.what_it_does: Review Inbox adds a status band above the Claude Code prompt and a drawer opened with /review-inbox, using the GitHub CLI (gh) under your own login. The To review tab lists PRs waiting for your review, each with a plain-language summary, risk markers, size and how long the request has waited. The My PRs tab shows your open PRs by state (changes requested, CI failing, conflicts, waiting, approved, merge queue, draft), and the Assigned & mentioned tab lists issues assigned to you and items that mention you. Selected PRs are added to your prompt as review requests, including a review-style line learned from your past review comments. Saved searches, a Notifications tab, and per-card buttons for follow-up prompts are also included. Optional settings enable direct GitHub writes (approve, mark ready, update branch, rerun failed CI, assign) and an auto review mode that stores reviews as your pending review on GitHub.
use_cases: Track pull requests waiting for my review
Monitor my own PRs for CI failures and requested changes
Find issues assigned to or mentioning me
Background-draft code reviews for incoming PRs
Get GitHub notifications inside Claude Code
how_to_run: /plugin marketplace add <marketplace source, left blank in the README>
stack: Claude Code 2.1.287 or later (mods / function-hook plugins)
Claude models (sonnet by default, opus optional) for summaries and auto reviews
notable: Band above the prompt shows only counts that need you, colored by how long the oldest review request has waited
Auto review drafts reviews in the background and keeps them as a pending review you post yourself
Review style is learned weekly from your own past review comments
Next-step buttons (Address comments, Fix CI, Resolve conflict) work in a new worktree without touching your branch
Interface and summaries available in nine languages
caveats: Auto review uses noticeably more tokens, with tens of thousands per PR and more on opus
Requires Claude Code 2.1.287 or later, and mods are in early access with API that may change
Notifications tab needs gh's own sign-in or a classic token; Windows without WSL keeps run folders in place
Lists are capped at 100 items per category
